about.p2: You don't need to learn code, hire a designer, or figure out hosting and domains. Tell us what to build, approve the preview, and go live.

items.a: Kumbuild is a done-for-you website service. You tell us what to build, and we build the website for you. You don't need to learn code or design anything in a tool.
3–5 working days after advance payment and complete content — until you get the preview link. If content comes late, the time moves ahead.
items.q: How many days will my website take?

items.a: Business name, services and prices, WhatsApp number, address, timings, and real photos. The full list is on the order page.
items.q: What do I need to give you?

items.a: Starter ₹3,999, Business ₹7,999, Premium ₹14,999 (all draft). Yearly renewal is ₹1,999 (draft).
items.q: How much will a website cost?

items.a: 50% advance at order time, the remaining 50% after approval, before the website goes live. Payment is through Razorpay — UPI, cards, netbanking and wallets.
2 revision rounds are free. See the preview, tell us the changes, and we will send a new preview. Extra rounds cost extra — amount to be decided.
items.q: What if I don't like the website?

items.a: Fill the form on kumbuild.com/order, choose a package, create an account and pay the advance.
Login at home.kumbuild.com — Orders shows the status: Received → In progress → Preview ready → Revision → Approved → Live.
items.q: Where do I check my order status?

items.a: Cancel before work starts and the full advance is refunded. After work starts, the advance is not refunded.
